method.unit: one steered generation per (probe dir, pair, steering target)
method.truth: the gullibility class the control probe steered toward
method.prediction: whichever reference reply the judge scored higher (ties broken by the judge's own 'closer' field)
method.reference_high: the pair's -P line: reply written for a gullible human
method.reference_low: the pair's -Q line: reply written for a non-gullible human
